newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China June industry output seen up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China June industry output seen up 12 pct.

text.p: China's industrial output is forecast to rise around 12 percent in June compared with the same month in 1996, state radio said on Saturday.
China's industrial output grew by 11.9 percent year-on-year in May to 178.0 billion yuan ($21.4 billion), the State Statistical Bureau has said.
The State Economic and Trade Commission was quoted by state radio as saying China's economy had entered a period of stable development.
